## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? Keep the distinction between implemented behaviour and future work clear. -->

## Related issue

<!-- Closes #... or explain why no issue is linked. -->

## Affected subsystem or library

<!-- For example: proxy generation, QuickJS lifecycle, membrane, marshaller, capability policy, compatibility harness, or a named library. -->

## Security and compatibility impact

<!-- Describe any change to capability exposure, isolation boundaries, host-supplied authority, or the evaluated compatibility contract. -->

## Validation

<!-- List exact commands and results. State any validation that could not be completed and why. -->

## Generated outputs

<!-- List generated bundles, proxies, result artifacts, or caches that were intentionally not committed. Write "None" when not applicable. -->

## Documentation and architecture

<!-- List documentation or ADR updates, or explain why none are needed. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I used an imperative Conventional Commit-style title where practical.
- [ ] I preserved unrelated local and untracked changes.
- [ ] I did not edit or commit generated bundles, proxies, or result artifacts.
- [ ] I added or updated a focused regression scenario for every feature/correction, where applicable.
- [ ] I ran the appropriate native/sandbox, compatibility, or security validation, where applicable.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation and architectural decisions, or explained why no update is needed.
